title: Strictness of the sealing gates
statement: Let $u,N,o$ be natural numbers with $u<N$ and $o<N$. Each of the three gates consisting, in order, of a NOT gate reading $u$, an OR gate reading $u$ and $N$, and an AND gate reading $o$ and $N+1$ has distinct arguments; the NOT gate has one argument and each other gate has two.
